libraries.name: Buckets
libraries.tagline: Sort items into named buckets using boolean rules over named, async conditions.
libraries.description: Declare named conditions over an item once, then declare buckets as boolean expressions over those conditions. Condition names, bucket names and the shape of the report are all inferred.

libraries.name: Step Queue
libraries.tagline: An extremely type-safe, step-based wrapper around BullMQ.
libraries.description: Define BullMQ jobs as a set of fully type-safe steps. Job data accumulates as it moves through the pipeline, and a retried job resumes on the exact step it left off at.

libraries.name: Stagehand
libraries.tagline: Fully typesafe saga-style script framework with modern terminal visuals.
libraries.description: Scripts are phases, phases are steps. Steps have a handler and an optional rollback that fires when a later step fails, with a typed context threaded through the whole run.

libraries.name: Search
libraries.tagline: A composable, type-safe search pipeline over arrays of strings.
libraries.description: Register the algorithms you want, hand it a dataset, and decide what order they run in and what happens when one hits. Registering an algorithm widens the pipeline's type, so an unregistered name in the run order is a compile error rather than a silent no-op.

libraries.name: Braid
libraries.tagline: Stitch a main collection to related detail collections with indexed, O(n + m) joins.
libraries.description: Declare what each detail source is and how it joins. Braid indexes every source once into a Map and does a single lookup per row, so adding a fourth source costs one more pass instead of another scan per row.

libraries.name: Stage
libraries.tagline: Edit values in steps with Immer drafts, then sync the net result in as few API calls as the API allows.
libraries.description: Track a value, edit it as many times as you like, and sync once. Edits collapse per value, reverted edits send nothing, and values of the same kind go out together through a bulk endpoint in batches the API accepts. Each .entity() call widens the stage type, so an unregistered name or a value of the wrong shape is a compile error.

libraries.name: Journal
libraries.tagline: A typed, file-backed journal of entries you can snapshot, mutate and revert.
libraries.description: Snapshot what a script is about to change, save it atomically, and restore from it when the change goes wrong. Entries validate with any Standard Schema library, types are inferred from the schema, and old files migrate through a typed version chain.
